Question 5
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with velocity v(t)=−5, where t is the time. If the particle is at the position x=3 when t=2, calculate the position x of the particle at time t>0.

a
x(t)=3
b
x(t)=3t−5
c
x(t)=−5t+13
d
x(t)=5t−7
e
x(t)=−5t+10
